svg.title: Prague Spring and Warsaw Pact Invasion of Czechoslovakia (August 1968)
svg.desc: Conic conformal GIS historical atlas map of Central and Eastern Europe showing Operation Danube on 20–21 August 1968, where ~500,000 Warsaw Pact troops invaded Czechoslovakia to crush Alexander Dubček's Prague Spring while Romania, Yugoslavia, and Albania condemned Soviet intervention.
